# Project

> How one person prepares and runs a project, from a problem to its result, with the fewest round trips: scope, review, baseline, plan, execution, refinement, each step a topic; and the folder a job leaves behind. Scope only; the review is not started.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Project](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
